listed_quote.quote: Neuberger Berman Municipal Fund Inc. (NYSE American: NBH), Neuberger Berman California Municipal Fund Inc. (NYSE American: NBW), and Neuberger Berman New York Municipal Fund Inc. (NYSE American: NBO)

deals.notes: The 2023-07-26 press release titled 'ANNOUNCE STOCKHOLDER APPROVAL OF PROPOSED REORGANIZATIONS' (accession 0000898432-23-000530) is shown only to its first lines; no excerpt states completion, so outcome is null. Meeting adjourned 2023-07-10 (accession 0000898432-23-000477). Later 2024 DEFA14A filings by the acquirer show no outcome text in the excerpts.
